description: This file defines a Switchboard class facilitating message-based communication between iframes and parent windows, including message handling, method registration, and message sending logic.

classes.name: Switchboard
classes.description: A utility class for message-based communication between windows or iframes, supporting method registration, message handling, and message sending.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Switchboard with provided parameters, setting up message event listeners.

methods.name: getMethodResult
methods.description: Handles the response to a method call, returning either the result or an error message.

methods.name: defineMethod
methods.description: Registers a method that can be called remotely via message passing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Calls a remote method and returns its result asynchronously.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Sends a message to invoke a method on the other side without waiting for a response.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the message port if not already started.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs debug messages if debug mode is enabled.

methods.name: getNewMessageId
methods.description: Generates a unique message ID for message correlation.
